prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station HOME screen during dock and arrival, 16:9, flat screen design filling the canvas. Edit the supplied screen (Image 1) and preserve every other pixel exactly: the vivarium with its plants, rocks, pool and burrow, the creature inside the cream ring and its plate, the small teal creature at the left, the red-capped creature at the right, the right-hand column of modules with the open bay, the rail, the rack, the dome and the seated handheld, and the layout of the top bar and bottom line.
THREE CHANGES ONLY: (1) TEXT: the top bar's right text becomes "Companion docked · 2 crates", ending about 60 px inside the right edge; the bottom line becomes orange "✓ Look at the new pods" at left, grey "the room" in the middle and grey "arrival playing" at right, ending about 60 px inside the right edge; same type, same sizes. (2) RIBBON: a slim slate band across the top edge of the stage, lying over the vivarium's top bezel from the left margin to the module column, with cream text "Expedition 4 home · 2 pods" centred on it. (3) NEST: the empty frosted-glass nest at the vivarium's lower right now holds Dot, a second creature of exactly the same species and colours as the one inside the ring in Image 2 (charcoal body, cream belly, three green leaf crown lobes), slightly smaller, curled up asleep with its eyes closed.
Only the text named in the changes is replaced; everything else stays exactly as it is.
Constraints: no new modules or objects; no digits on the bench; no logos; the sleeping creature is the same species and colours as the one in the ring, never a cat, dog or rodent.
preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the screen to edit. Image 2 is the accepted rich Pip, the same species as the sleeping creature to draw in the nest.

imageInputs.role: edit target: the composite of the approved Home with the bay, rack and dock region edits
accepted rich Pip: the species and colours Dot shares; Pip itself stays unchanged in Image 1

result.disposition: kept as runner-up (the same edit held; Dot slightly less clean)
